mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_key FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.delete_flag = 0 AND r.delete_flag = 0 AND r.status = 1
